title: 第847章 神魂符箓第846章 妖兽鹫鹍
lines: 一尊巨大的凤麟法相，在李骏身后缓缓凝聚！
凤仪更是在他周身盘旋，火焰与雷光交织。
旋转的凤仪在李骏的操控下，飞刺向项龙，给舒畅创造脱身的机会。
另外，李骏抬手就是一刀！
直接逼退一名近身的金丹修士！
另一股更强气息骤然降临！
对方根本不止一个元婴！
真正能抗衡元婴的只有小岐和舒畅的护道者。
而那护道者，如今还被镇龙钟困住！
双方疯狂厮杀，山林不断崩塌，巨石炸裂，树木成片倒下。
李骏一边抵挡，一边飞速思考，他观察到了安栀予落于危难，小岐更是吃力，以一敌二，挡住了元婴妖兽鹫鹍和元婴修士麻施罗。
他一直站在后方冷眼旁观。
周围空气仿佛都沉重起来。
content_en:
at this time.
Li Jun has completely exploded.
"Fenglin changes!"
Boom! ! !
Fierce spiritual light soared into the sky!
The cry of phoenix resounds through the mountains and forests!
A huge Fenglin statue slowly condensed behind Li Jun!
Half phoenix and half lin!
The pressure is amazing!
Feng Yi was hovering around him, flames and thunder intertwined.
Under the control of Li Jun, the spinning Feng Yi stabbed at Xiang Long, giving Shu Chang a chance to escape.
In addition, Li Jun raised his hand and slashed with a knife!
"Boom!!!"
"Breaking the air!"
The sword energy carries thunder and fire across the sweep!
Directly force back a close golden elixir monk!
However, the next moment.
Another stronger breath suddenly arrived!
Li Jun raised his head suddenly.
"Nascent Soul cultivator?!"
He finally noticed.
The other party has more than one Nascent Soul at all!
Shen Pingyi sneered.
"That's right."
"Here we are—"
"Four Nascent Souls, what are you fighting with?!"
Li Jun's heart suddenly sank.
On their side.
The only ones who can really compete with Nascent Soul are Xiao Qi and Shu Chang's guardians.
And that protector is still trapped by the Dragon Suppressing Bell!
Situation——
Deterioration instantly!
——
Boom boom boom! ! !
The two sides fought wildly, the mountain forest continued to collapse, boulders exploded, and trees fell in pieces.
Li Jun resisted while thinking quickly. He observed that An Zhiyu was in danger, and Xiao Qi struggled even more. One against two, he blocked the Nascent Soul monster Jiu Kun and the Nascent Soul cultivator Masi Luo.
Just at this moment.
Nascent Soul monk Mi Chen moved.
The first level of Nascent Soul.
He stood back and watched with cold eyes.
It wasn't until now that he finally took action.
"The farce is over."
He took one step forward.
The spiritual pressure suddenly came!
The air around me seemed to be heavy.
